display_long_description:
Experience 3D dating in VR with profiles from around the world. Dating.com VR offers immersive 1-on-1 video calls with matches who share your interests, so you can see, hear, and connect with people as if they were right in front of you. Step into a new dimension of romance with Dating.com VR.

Discover deep, immersive VR connections:
- Expressive VR profiles
- Meet people from anywhere in the world
- Fun, warm 1-on-1 VR calls
- Meaningful connections that can grow into real love
- Safe, easy, convenient (with moderation tools for a respectful environment)


# REAL SINGLES, 3D WORLD

Meet new people globally in a realistic virtual space, feel the chemistry, and stay close across any distance.

# CONNECT IN VIRTUAL REALITY
Leave swiping behind. Dating.com VR focuses on what truly matters – emotions, spark, and shared moments.

# MATCH PERFECTLY IN VR
Find standout profiles with our Popular Members feature, then share a 1-on-1 video call face-to-face in the virtual world and let the moment unfold.

# IMPORTANT MONETIZATION DETAILS
- Use credits to unlock access to chat and connect via VR.
- Your account will be charged once you confirm your purchase.
- One-time in-app purchases for credits used to access premium VR chats. No subscription required.

 Our platform includes content moderation tools to help ensure a safe experience.
Download Dating.com VR and start your first unforgettable VR date today.
